title: Ryanair signs five-year Google Cloud deal, expands use of AI in airline operations
title_zh: 瑞安航空签署为期五年的谷歌云协议，扩大人工智能在航空公司运营中的使用
summary: Ryanair said on Wednesday it would deploy Google's Gemini AI tools and DeepMind models ‌across its operations under a new five-year cloud partnership, using ‌the technology to help manage crew scheduling and make operational decisions.
summary_zh: 瑞安航空周三表示，根据一项新的五年云合作伙伴关系，将在其运营中部署谷歌的 Gemini AI 工具和 DeepMind 模型，利用该技术帮助管理机组人员调度并做出运营决策。

title: Wall Street ends down as US-Iran peace optimism fades
title_zh: 随着美伊和平乐观情绪消退，华尔街收跌

title: CoreWeave jumps 10% following Q2 earnings
title_zh: 第二季度盈利后 CoreWeave 上涨 10%
summary: Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley breaks down CoreWeave (CRWV) Q2 results.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经技术编辑 Dan Howley 详细分析了 CoreWeave (CRWV) 第二季度业绩。

title: Older Americans are dropping out of the workforce. Blame the soaring stock market.
title_zh: 年长的美国人正在退出劳动力市场。归咎于股市的飙升。
summary: Droves of older workers are stepping out of the workforce, and a new Bank of America Securities report says wealth generated from a surging stock market could be an underlying factor.
summary_zh: 大批老年工人正在退出劳动力市场，美国银行证券公司的一份新报告称，股市飙升所产生的财富可能是一个潜在因素。

title: Intel's huge rally is helping pay for its AI comeback
title_zh: 英特尔的大幅上涨为其人工智能卷土重来提供了资金
summary: In today's Chart of the Day, Yahoo Finance Markets & Data Editor Jared Blikre dives into Intel's (INTC) rally and how the chipmaker’s surging stock price saved the company millions as it prepares to issue $20 billion in new common stock.
summary_zh: 在今天的每日图表中，雅虎财经市场和数据编辑 Jared Blikre 深入探讨了英特尔 (INTC) 的涨势，以及这家芯片制造商在准备发行 200 亿美元新普通股之际，股价飙升如何为该公司节省了数百万美元。

title: Can SpaceX really reach $100B in annual recurring revenue by 2027?
title_zh: 到 2027 年，SpaceX 的年度经常性收入真的能达到 100B 美元吗？
summary: Deutsche Bank predicts that SpaceX (SPCX) will hit $100 billion in annual recurring revenue (ARR) by the end of 2026. Yahoo Finance Senior Business Reporter Ines Ferré and PNC Asset Management Group chief investment officer Amanda Agati share their thoughts.
summary_zh: 德意志银行预测，到 2026 年底，SpaceX (SPCX) 的年度经常性收入 (ARR) 将达到 1000 亿美元。雅虎财经高级商业记者 Ines Ferré 和 PNC 资产管理集团首席投资官 Amanda Agati 分享了他们的想法。

title: Why this week's CoreWeave earnings are so important for markets
title_zh: 为什么本周的 CoreWeave 收益对市场如此重要
summary: CoreWeave (CRWV) is set to report quarterly earnings this week. Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma discusses more in the video above.
summary_zh: CoreWeave (CRWV) 将于本周公布季度收益。雅虎财经高级记者布鲁克·迪帕尔玛在上面的视频中讨论了更多内容。

title: Airbnb CEO Brian Chesky on AI's future: One person can be a billion-dollar company
title_zh: Airbnb 首席执行官 Brian Chesky 谈人工智能的未来：一个人可以成为一家价值十亿美元的公司
summary: Airbnb CEO Brian Chesky throws down a few tech predictions.
summary_zh: Airbnb 首席执行官布莱恩·切斯基 (Brian Chesky) 推翻了一些科技预测。

title: Microsoft stock just cleared a big hurdle but still trails the S&P 500
title_zh: 微软股价刚刚扫清了一大障碍，但仍落后于标准普尔 500 指数
summary: The bulls are back in control of Microsoft stock.
summary_zh: 多头重新控制了微软股票。
